ex.t: They set up a new company.
We brought the meeting forward by a day.
We put the meeting off until next week.
The CEO is stepping down next month.
We need to sort out the problem.

title.ko: carry out · set up · take on · bring forward · put off · follow up
title.en: carry out · set up · take on · bring forward · put off · follow up

explain.ko: 업무에서 자주 쓰는 구동사는 격식 있는 동사로 바꿀 수도 있지만 일상 업무 대화에서는 구동사가 더 자연스럽습니다. carry out(= conduct), set up(= establish), take on(= accept), bring forward(= advance), put off(= postpone), follow up(= pursue further), deal with(= handle), take over(= assume control), step down(= resign), sort out(= resolve)입니다. 구동사는 분리형(put the meeting off)과 비분리형(deal with the problem)이 있으므로 대명사를 쓸 때는 put it off처럼 사이에 둡니다.
explain.en: Work-related phrasal verbs are natural in everyday workplace talk, though formal verbs can replace them: carry out (= conduct), set up (= establish), take on (= accept), bring forward (= advance), put off (= postpone), follow up (= pursue), deal with (= handle), take over (= assume control), step down (= resign), sort out (= resolve). Some are separable (put the meeting off) and others inseparable (deal with the problem); with a pronoun put it in the middle: put it off.

notes.ko: 분리형 구동사의 목적어가 대명사이면 사이에 놓습니다. put it off(○), put off it(×)
notes.en: A pronoun goes between the verb and particle: put it off.

notes.ko: deal with, step down처럼 분리되지 않는 구동사가 있습니다.
격식 있는 글에서는 postpone, establish 같은 한 단어 동사가 어울립니다.
notes.en: In formal writing use one-word verbs like postpone.

lines.t: We set up a new department last month. The team carried out a customer survey and made a service improvement plan based on the results. Some tasks were put off until next week and the extra work was taken on by a new employee.

prompt.ko: 업무와 관련된 구동사 4개를 써서 한 회사의 일을 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write 4 sentences about a company's work, using four work-related phrasal verbs.

task.model: Our team carried out a customer survey last month. The team leader brought the meeting forward by a day and took on a new project. When the CEO steps down next month, the vice president will take over the company. Before that, we need to sort out a few problems.

model_trans.ko: 우리 팀은 지난달 고객 조사를 수행했어요. 팀장은 회의를 하루 앞당겼고 새 프로젝트도 맡았어요. 사장이 다음 달에 물러나면 부사장이 회사를 인수할 거예요. 그 전에 몇 가지 문제를 해결해야 해요.
model_trans.en: Our team carried out a customer survey last month. The team leader brought the meeting forward by a day and took on a new project. When the CEO steps down next month, the vice president will take over the company. Before that, we need to sort out a few problems.
